next_step: Closed - procurement selected hyperscaler managed endpoints; follow-up for future proofing workshop Q1 FY26
notes:
Account summary: late-stage procurement for LLM-powered telemetry pipeline. Heavy emphasis on VPC + KMS + on-prem fallback. Procurement mandate: consolidate model endpoints with their hyperscaler partner (AWS) to use committed credits. Short timeline once procurement locked (2-4 weeks).

Key reasons lost:
- Procurement decision to stay with AWS managed endpoints (SageMaker/Bedrock) — cited vendor consolidation and cloud credit utilization.
- Security exec prioritized hyperscaler native logging and identity integration; easier path for audit controls with existing AWS tooling.
- Internal champion (ML infra lead) left in Oct; new champion not engaged quickly.
- POC demonstrated performance but not enough to overcome migration/ops inertia and procurement constraints.

Quote from head of ML ops: "We liked Redwood's perf but the CFO said we have to exhaust committed cloud credits and standardize on AWS endpoints."

Commercials: estimated ARR $150-300k annual; Redwood offered dedicated pool + private control plane pricing. Procurement asked for a hybrid pilot (Redwood + AWS) but legal flagged complexity.

Follow-ups: closed-lost recorded 2025-11-28. Suggested Q1 FY26 re-engagement for cost/quality comparison once their first-month run on AWS endpoints completes.
